english: Librarians can read and update the catalogue. Members can only read it.
Support agents can read tickets while they are on shift. They can also close tickets (write), but only when they are on shift and are senior agents.
Developers can deploy to production when the change is approved or during an emergency, but never during a code freeze.
shows: OR, plus a DENY exception that wins

english: Doctors have full access to patient records while on shift, and nurses can read them while on shift. Nobody may access patient records from an unmanaged device.
shows: "nobody" must become a DENY for every subject

english: Interns can view dashboards, but only when supervised and not working remotely. Analysts can view and edit dashboards, except that a locked dashboard can only be viewed.
